metadata.method_name: Plan-noise crosswalk: dose unit x direction seeds, profile split and prices at D* (step K)
metadata.description: Qwen/Qwen3-8B b968826d, bf16 HF transformers 4.57.6 (exp29 engine d numerics), thinking off. Per-sample isotropic random direction u at the task-spec positions of blocks 12-23, prefill only, displacement-targeted to alpha * unit[l, p]. The 2x2 crosses the dose unit (U_abs = the ban's own per-cell displacement norm; U_bf = ||h_twin|| x r_Q(l)) with the direction seeds (S4 exp29/exp19, S5 exp27) on shared CRN slots and one decoding path; U_bf* splits per-block energy from within-block profile; S2 restricts U_abs to its top-quartile cells; S3 prices PN at D* against iteration 5's knobs on full-simplex randomisation hulls.

novelty_audit.manual_note: Manual pass (agent): all five correct 'other' programs on T03 are the same mechanism -- a hash-map frequency count, a sort of the distinct keys, then a walk of cumulative counts until k is covered. This is counting sort with key compression (equivalently a full sort of the distinct values with multiplicities): a CATALOGUE_VARIANT of counting_sort / full_sort, not a new algorithm. Nearest known solutions (max Jaccard 0.22-0.40, kodcode/xlcost) use the same frequency-then-sorted-keys pattern.

G4.outlier_rule_note: exp22 units.json LISTS outlier cells (T03, T05, T10: spec position 3 at blocks 12-16, n 36-106 against block medians 3-6; T2: position 3 at block 14 and position 87 -- a '0' digit token whose residual norm jumps to ~10,290 at block 16, a massive activation -- at blocks 16-23 with n ~748, 82% of T2's U_abs energy; T1: none) but defines no exclusion rule, and exp22/exp29's ctx4.ban_unit loads the raw unit. This artifact therefore uses the raw unit, so D1 reproduces exp29's design; the T2 consequences for P_top / P_rest / P_shuf and U_bf* are reported (results/unit_profiles.json, README).

suite_T1_T2.note: gate_report.json's 0.843 / 0.888 are over the 89 resolved eval items; this re-check scores all 92 (3 unresolved count as misses), exactly as iteration 5's recheck did (0.8043 / 0.8587)

engine_check.reference: exp30 data/labels.jsonl TWIN rows (bf16 HF engine, RTX 2000 Ada, max_new 384)

knob_check.rule: reuse exp27's N 50 rows (relabelled) iff per-slot label agreement >= 0.95 (10/10)

timing.staged_scaling: anchors ran W1 (20 rows, the 10-slot stage) before W2-W5; the measured s/program (T10 ~0.4 s, T2 ~0.6 s at B = 12) put the whole plan far inside the budget, so every cell ran at its full N and nothing in the drop order was dropped

deviations.deviation: GPU is an RTX 4090 (24 GB, sm_89), not the planned RTX A4500 (20 GB); the memory probe chose B = 12 (the largest candidate) and every instruct row ran at B = 12 on the shared-prefix path with the full KV buffer.
deviations.consequence: faster than planned; cross-GPU kernel sensitivity is bounded by the anchors (T10 D1 per-slot agreement with exp29 engine d 0.98) and the S0 engine check.

deviations.deviation: After the anchor cells (W1 first, then W2-W5) the GPU continued with the remaining S1 cells while the anchors were labelled (both anchors passed: 26/50 and 1/50), instead of pausing for the labels.
deviations.consequence: none: every S1 cell runs under every anchor outcome; DIAG and the left-padded diagnostic were not needed.

deviations.deviation: Knob-check agreement was counted on (label, passed) pairs, stricter than label-only agreement.
deviations.consequence: conservative: 8 of 25 (task, knob) cells failed the 10/10 rule (T03 EAP, IFG_hot, T1.3; T10, T2, T05 EAP; T1 BINT, EAP) and were regenerated here at k 2-9 (320 rows); 17 cells reuse exp27's relabelled rows (cross-engine, see knob_check.json).

deviations.deviation: S0 engine check vs exp30's bf16 twins (RTX 2000 Ada, max_new 384-640): label-and-pass agreement 15/16 on T2 and 15/16 on T03 (planned >= 0.95; one slot each diverged mid-program), 40/40 on T10 and T05, 34/40 on T1 (all bfs; 6 pass flips).
deviations.consequence: logged as cross-GPU kernel sensitivity (identical code 0.81 T2, 0.94 T03, 0.48 T1); every contrast of this artifact is within one engine, and the anchors reproduce exp29/exp27 per slot (T10 D1 0.98, T2 D1 0.88).

deviations.deviation: Gate G2's exp8-suite gold-set accuracy is 0.804 runtime / 0.859 AST over all 92 eval items, against the gate report's 0.843 / 0.888 over its 89 resolved items; exactly iteration 5's recheck values.
deviations.consequence: none on labels: the labeller version is unchanged; the gate passes on equality with iteration 5's recheck.

deviations.deviation: label_k.py amended before any S3 row to follow data/raw/knobs_norm.jsonl (integer sample ids).
analysis_k.py amended after S1/S2 rows existed and before E1 rows: Monte-Carlo sign-flip p reported as (hits+1)/(N+1); mediation restricted to alpha 1-2; E1 summary added.
deviations.consequence: post hoc but conservative (p can no longer be 0); decision rules unchanged; Holm decisions identical.

deviations.deviation: Exploratory E1 (not in the plan): D3 (U_bf x S4) at alpha 3, 4, 6 on T10 and T2 (N 50 each), hash-committed before its first row, run after COMMIT #2 with spare GPU time.
deviations.consequence: descriptive only; never enters a pre-registered test.

deviations.deviation: Exploratory E3 (not in the plan): T10 fresh slots k 10-19 for D1-D5 and the three profiles, and a T03 2x2 (D2-D4 at alpha 2, k 0-9), hash-committed before its first row.
deviations.consequence: descriptive replication only; AMENDMENT 3 pins every committed analysis to its committed slots.

deviations.deviation: analysis_k.py amended after the E3 rows existed: committed S1 / D5 / mediation / D* analyses read only their committed slots (T10 k 0-9; T2 alpha 2 k 0-19, alpha 1 k 0-9).
deviations.consequence: none: the committed numbers are identical to the pre-E3 run (verified field by field).

deviations.deviation: On T2 the P_rest profile (rescaled to U_abs's Frobenius norm while holding only 3.7% of its energy) puts per-cell doses up to ~5x U_abs on the rest cells and breaks the programs (pass 0.00).
deviations.consequence: the T2 top-vs-rest contrast is confounded by breakage; the committed primary S2 reading is T10.

deviations.deviation: Judges: mistralai/mistral-medium-3.1 and moonshotai/kimi-k2 (two families), deepseek-chat-v3.1 as the third; the manual class is the agent's read of the judges' reasons and the code.
RLIMIT_AS is not set in the CUDA processes (it breaks CUDA's virtual-address reservations); VRAM is capped with set_per_process_memory_fraction(0.97) instead.

design_table.D1: U_abs x S4 (exp29 engine-d design: positive anchor)
design_table.D4: U_bf x S5 (exp27 design: null anchor)
design_table.PTOP: U_abs restricted to its top-quartile cells, rescaled to ||U_abs||_F; other cells not edited (S4 seeds)
design_table.PREST: U_abs restricted to the other three quartiles, rescaled to ||U_abs||_F; top cells not edited (S4)
design_table.PSHUF: U_abs with spec positions permuted (one permutation for all blocks, seed stable_seed(task,'SHUF'))

seed_functions.S5: u = normalise(PCG64(stable_seed(task, 'PN5', w, k)).standard_normal(4096)) (same u at alpha 1, 2)
seed_functions.u_stream: PCG64(stable_seed(task, w, k)).random(max_new); one stream per slot shared by every arm

commit1.edit: TARGET at blocks 12-23 x task-spec positions [p1, spec_end), prefill only: h <- h + (alpha n[l,p] - (h - h_twin).u) u; masked profile cells not edited

cells.T10: D1-D4 x alpha {1,2} x N 50 (W1-W5 x k 0-9)
cells.T2: D1-D4 x alpha 2 x N 100 (k 0-19); alpha 1 x N 50 (k 0-9)
cells.D5: T10 alpha 2 N 50; T2 alpha 2 N 100
cells.S2: T10, T2 alpha 2 N 50: PTOP, PREST, PSHUF

commit1.decoding: T 1.0, top-p 1, no top-k, max_new 1024 (bench) / 1536 (T1, T2), fence stop, exact inverse-CDF CRN; shared-prefix path for every row; constant B (memory probe); designs interleaved by slot

outcomes.Y: passed AND label in catalogue minus default (primary)
outcomes.Y_any: passed AND label not in {default, invalid, disputed, unknown}
outcomes.A: valid AND label not in {default, invalid, disputed, unknown}, over all N

anchor_rules.A1: T10 D1 alpha 2 attempted off-default (A) has two-sided Fisher p >= 0.05 vs exp29 engine-d 25/50 AND count >= 15
anchor_rules.A2: T10 D4 alpha 2 correct off-default (Y_any) has two-sided Fisher p >= 0.05 vs exp27's 1/50
anchor_rules.A3: reported only: T2 D1 alpha 2 vs exp29 22/50 attempts (pass 0.62; 9/50 correct); per-slot label agreement of D1 with exp29 raw_d on k 0-9
anchor_rules.on_failure: DIAG -> results/anchor_discrepancy.json; if A2 fails run T10 D4 alpha 2 through exp27's left-padded path (N 50); finish S1; S1 verdict 'ANCHOR_FAILED: not interpreted'; D* := D1

decision_rules.contrasts: RD_unit = ((D1-D3)+(D2-D4))/2; RD_seed = ((D1-D2)+(D3-D4))/2; INT = (D1-D2)-(D3-D4); slot-cluster bootstrap 95% CI (2,000); exact sign-flip p; Holm over {unit, seed, INT} on T10 alpha 2 (outcome Y)
decision_rules.UNIT: RD_unit CI > 0 (Holm p < 0.05) and RD_seed CI contains 0
decision_rules.SEEDS: RD_seed CI excludes 0 (Holm p < 0.05) and RD_unit CI contains 0
decision_rules.NEITHER-ALL-MOVE: no contrast and every design share >= 0.2
decision_rules.NEITHER-NONE-MOVE: no contrast and every design share < 0.1
decision_rules.D5_split: RD(D1 - D5) = within-block profile at matched per-block energy; RD(D5 - D3) = per-block energy at the ban-free shape
decision_rules.S2: exact McNemar on per-slot Y; Holm over 3 per task (T10 primary): PTOP vs PREST, D1 vs PSHUF, D1 vs PTOP; 'pushes act where bans write' iff PTOP > PREST (p < 0.05) and D1 > PSHUF (p < 0.05) on T10
decision_rules.D_star: argmax over D1-D4 of pooled (T10 + T2) alpha-2 Y share among designs with T10 pass >= 0.8 x twin pass; ties within 0.10 go to D1

predictions.P-S1a: unit main effect RD (U_abs - U_bf, averaged over seeds) on T10 alpha 2 > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0 (point +0.35, range 0.20-0.50)
predictions.P-S1b: seed main effect within [-0.10, +0.10], CI includes 0
predictions.P-S1d: T2 alpha 2 unit RD on correct programs +0.10 (CI may include 0)

s3_rules.classes: PN* = {TWIN, PN*_a1, PN*_a2}; BINT = {TWIN, BINT}; EAP = {TWIN, EAP}; IFG = {TWIN, IFG_hot}; TEMP = {TWIN, T1.3}; TOPK10 = {TWIN, TOPK10}
s3_rules.hull: exp27 hull_full.hull_prices_full: correct-only Hill-1 rarefied at depth 25, two-stage CRN multinomial draws (n_draws 1,000), simplex grid 0.01 (k <= 3) + local refinement -> H5, P15, P20; 2,000 slot bootstraps with best-mixture selection inside each replicate
s3_rules.per_task: WIN if P_boot(H5_PN* > H5_BINT) >= 0.8, LOSS if <= 0.2, else TIE; 'matches or beats' = WIN/TIE
s3_rules.replay: D_t = H5_PN* - max(H5 of BINT, EAP, IFG); D_bar with bootstrap CI; count PN* >= best text
s3_rules.knob_check: reuse exp27's N 50 rows (relabelled) iff per-slot label agreement >= 0.95 (10/10) on k 0-1
s3_rules.retag: iteration-5 plan-sampler verdict and movability verdict tagged 'ban-free unit and iteration-5 seeds'; new verdicts at D*: movable := alpha-2 correct off-default share - twin >= 0.20 at pass >= 0.8 x twin
